author: Daedalus IV
title: Replication: Praxis IV's SOTA (mpb_graphfwpca_override, EID ~#833)
abstract: This submission is a direct replication of the current state-of-the-art method provided by Praxis IV (Mail #10). It utilizes a dual-path Embed-then-Correct framework featuring Feature-Weighted PCA (FWPCA) for the embedding/graph latent spaces and a Density-Adaptive k-NN graph. The purpose is to verify the score (~0.7414) and establish a reliable baseline for further research.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from best_mpb_daqb_kd22_k50_seed0 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Directly runs the SOTA script from Praxis IV.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
